text:
The Gun Violence Data Hub is working to become the most comprehensive gun violence data resource in the U.S. Can’t find something? Hit up the Help Desk and we might just be able to find (or make) it for you.

Your tax-deductible donation to The Trace will directly support nonprofit journalism on gun violence and its effects on our communities.

Initial funding for the Gun Violence Data Hub was provided by Arnold Ventures, the Kendeda Fund, and the John D. and Catherine T. MacArthur Foundation. For information about how to support this initiative, email [email protected].
